labels.description: The named conflicts behind the operational disruption (the conflict between Russia and Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East) are dropped in favor of generic 'international conflicts', and the tariff risk now adds tariffs that increase suppliers' sourcing costs, alongside a roll-forward from 2024/2025 to 2025/2026 and 'intensified inflation' becoming 'high rates of inflation'.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: specific named conflicts are dropped, and criterion 1: a new exposure (tariffs raising suppliers' sourcing costs) is disclosed, so the section is material even though the year changes are routine.

labels.description: The phrase 'among other factors' is inserted so innovation success 'depends on, among other factors,' the same listed abilities, with no factor added or removed.
labels.rationale: Minor: a stylistic hedge that marks the existing list as non-exhaustive without naming any new risk, factor or change in likelihood or severity.

labels.description: The customer dependency is broadened from 'key retail or foodservice customers' to 'key customers' in both the heading and the closing sentences on relationship maintenance and customer loss.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the scope of the disclosed customer-loss risk is widened from two named customer types to all key customers.

labels.description: The text is identical; only the position of the page number 13 marker within the section changed.
labels.rationale: Minor: a pagination artifact with no change in wording or substance.

labels.description: Covers the risk that the Company and the Coca-Cola system cannot attract, retain and inspire outstanding talent, maintain a supportive culture, plan management succession or design work models that meet employee expectations.

Covered the risk that the Company could not attract, hire, develop, motivate and retain specialized or top talent with diverse perspectives, experiences and backgrounds reflecting its consumers and markets, plus related succession, culture and work-model risks.

Tariffs that increase suppliers' sourcing costs are added to the list of factors driving input price volatility, alongside the inflation outlook rolling from 2025 to 2026, 'derived' becoming 'derived and manufactured', and minor punctuation and pronoun edits.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a new cost exposure (tariffs raising suppliers' sourcing costs) is disclosed, which makes the section material despite the otherwise routine edits.
